title.tr: Tezgahta yatan bölmeli raf iskeleti, arkada el aletleri
title.en: Compartmented shelf frame lying on the bench, hand tools behind

alt.tr: Mavi atölye tezgahında yatay duran bölmeli açık renk ahşap raf iskeleti; arkada duvarda el aletleri
alt.en: A light timber compartmented shelf frame lying flat on a blue workshop bench, with hand tools on the wall behind

caption.tr: Raf iskeleti yan yatırılmış, bölmeleri yukarıdan seçiliyor. Arkada duvara asılı pense ve el aletleri görünüyor.
caption.en: The shelf frame is laid on its side and its compartments show from above. Pliers and hand tools hang on the wall behind.
